archetypes.name: Bullet Surge
archetypes.philosophy: Focus on rapid tree planting and aggressive bullet donation to achieve Victory Points early, using minimal army for defense while maximizing economic output.
key_changes: In Gardener.java, remove all robot building and prioritize planting trees in every direction, increasing density.
In Archon.java, set donation threshold to 0 bullets, donating immediately to rush VP even with low reserves.
In Gardener.java, add logic to water trees only when necessary, freeing up actions for planting.
Modify Nav.java to keep units stationary near archons for maximum tree farming efficiency.
In RobotPlayer.java, limit archon hiring to focus on 3-4 gardeners for clustered tree farms.
archetypes.engagement_style: Passive defense with scouts intercepting threats, otherwise fully focused on economy

archetypes.name: Infantry Onslaught
archetypes.philosophy: Spam cheap soldiers early to overwhelm enemy before they can establish their economy, leveraging map edges for flanking attacks.
key_changes: In Gardener.java, set buildOrder to {RobotType.SOLDIER} exclusively for the first 800 rounds.
Modify Nav.java tryMoveBug to aggressively cross Lanes tree bands by finding gaps and moving North/South when blocked.
In Soldier.java fire(), add kiting logic to maintain distance from enemy tanks while firing triad shots.
In Archon.java, reduce gardener hiring to 2-3 and increase donation only after soldiers are produced.
Add soldier clustering in RobotPlayer.java to coordinate pushes through broadcasted waypoints.
archetypes.engagement_style: Aggressive all-in pushes, targeting enemy archons and gardeners first

archetypes.name: Armored Citadel
archetypes.philosophy: Build defensive tank formations to protect expanding tree farms, using tanks to body-ram through trees and control territory.
key_changes: In Gardener.java, prioritize TANK builds in buildOrder for early and mid game.
In Tank.java, implement patrol patterns around gardener clusters to block enemy access.
Modify Nav.java for tanks to use body-ramming trees when navigating to positions.
In Gardener.java, make gardeners plant trees in circular formations around tanks for protected farming.
In Archon.java, adjust donation to maintain 500 bullet reserve for emergency builds.
archetypes.engagement_style: Defensive turtling with occasional snipe opportunities, tanks leading territorial expansions

archetypes.name: Vision Raiders
archetypes.philosophy: Deploy scout swarms to harass enemy gardeners and gather intel, disrupting economy while main army advances through cleared paths.
key_changes: In Gardener.java, set buildOrder to mostly SCOUT for first 600 rounds.
In Scout.java, add gardener-hunting behavior: move towards enemy archon locations and prioritize firing at gardeners.
Implement scout coordination in Nav.java: scouts broadcast tree gap locations to team for army routing.
In Soldier.java, add support for following scout-marked paths through Lanes bands.
Reduce tree planting in Gardener.java to free up build cooldowns for more scout production.
archetypes.engagement_style: Hit-and-run harassment tactics, scouts kiting away from danger while army pushes

archetypes.name: Tree Cleaver Rush
archetypes.philosophy: Rush lumberjacks to clear tree bands quickly, attacking enemy base directly through forest gaps with melee superiority.
key_changes: In Gardener.java, buildOrder = {RobotType.LUMBERJACK} until 400 rounds.
In Lumberjack.java, modify movement to aggressively chop towards enemy archons, using band navigation to flank.
Add lumberjack strike priority for archons in RobotPlayer.java runLumberjack.
In Nav.java, disable tree collision avoidance for lumberjacks to charge through dense areas.
In Gardener.java, disable tree planting to maximize lumberjack production speed.
archetypes.engagement_style: Direct charging attacks through cleared paths, targeting high-value units

archetypes.name: Economic Escalator
archetypes.philosophy: Early survival with tree farming, then explosive late-game scaling with massive army production to dominate.
key_changes: In Gardener.java, no building before round 800, focus entirely on tree planting and watering.
After round 800, switch to pure SOLDIER builds in massive quantities.
In Archon.java, conserve bullets early (donate only when >1000), spend freely late.
Modify Gardener movement to be stationary until late game, then move towards enemy.
Add late-game build acceleration by reducing plant attempts in favor of quick builds.
archetypes.engagement_style: Stationary turtle early, all-out offensive push late with overwhelming numbers

archetypes.name: Versatile Vanguard
archetypes.philosophy: Maintain balanced unit composition with tanks for frontline, soldiers for damage, and scouts for vision, adapting to opponent strategy.
key_changes: In Gardener.java, fixed buildOrder = {RobotType.TANK, RobotType.SOLDIER, RobotType.SCOUT}.
In Tank.java, implement formation logic to protect soldiers from behind.
Add scout intel broadcasting for enemy positions to coordinate team movement.
In Soldier.java, fire triad/pentad when tanks provide cover, avoiding friendly fire.
Adjust movement in Nav.java to maintain unit spacing for effective formations.
archetypes.engagement_style: Coordinated mixed-unit advances, using complementary strengths for breakthroughs

archetypes.name: Garden Overgrowth
archetypes.philosophy: Spawn excessive gardeners to create vast tree forests, donating bullets at maximum speed for Victory Point victory.
key_changes: In Archon.java, remove hiring limit, hire gardeners continuously if possible.
In Gardener.java, disable robot building entirely, only plant and water trees.
Add garden clustering: gardeners broadcast locations to group together for dense planting.
In Archon.java, donate all bullets above 50 for immediate VP gains.
Disable all unit movement, keeping everything stationary for optimal tree growth.
archetypes.engagement_style: Completely passive, relying on economy to win before enemy can attack

archetypes.name: Mobile Marauders
archetypes.philosophy: Fast moving scout-soldier groups roam the map, attacking isolated enemy units and disrupting supply lines.
key_changes: In Gardener.java, buildOrder focusing on SCOUT and SOLDIER mobility.
In Nav.java, implement randomized roaming patterns for exploration and harassment.
Add unit grouping logic: broadcast positions to form 2-3 unit squads.
In Scout.java, prioritize shaking trees for bullet collection while moving.
Modify engagement to flee when outnumbered, attacking only weak targets.
archetypes.engagement_style: Guerrilla warfare with hit-and-run tactics across the map

archetypes.name: Donation Dash
archetypes.philosophy: Minimal investment in units or trees, focus on acquiring and donating bullets as fast as possible for rapid VP gain.
key_changes: In Archon.java, donate immediately even with 10 bullets, prioritizing speed over reserve.
In Gardener.java, build only 1 SCOUT per gardener, no trees or other units.
Disable watering and reduce planting to 1 tree per gardener for minimal income.
Make all units stationary to conserve bytecode, scouts only for shaking nearby trees.
In Soldier.java, avoid combat, move only to collect bullets from neutral trees.
archetypes.engagement_style: Minimal engagement, fleeing all threats to focus on economic goals
